quote.text:
So I'm just really happy that at the end,
我很高兴

I found my way and just played great.
最终找到了办法，也打得很好。

And obviously it's been a really emotional
这一周让我感慨万千，

and an amazing week for me
也非常美妙。

that I learned a lot, you know,
我也学到了很多。

to keep going forward step by step,
继续一步一步向前走，

playing on indoor courts,
在室内场上比赛，

trying to gain more confidence playing on this surface.
努力在这种场地上积累信心。

So I'm just really happy
所以我很高兴，

and looking forward for the rest of the season.
也期待赛季接下来的比赛。
